quotaExceeded.error: DOMException: QuotaExceededError - The quota has been exceeded.
quotaExceeded.analysis: saveData() lacks try-catch block; 14,000 log entries generate ~5.18 MB JSON payload exceeding browser 5 MB localStorage quota.

invalidDateExport.analysis: new Date('invalid') instanceof Date is true, but calling .toISOString() throws uncaught RangeError, breaking data export.

emptyGroupLoop.analysis: isMuscleGroupCompleted returns true when groupExercises.length === 0, causing checkAndAdvanceWeek() to advance weeks 0->1->2->3 and complete cycle automatically.

exerciseSearchLatency.analysis: handleExerciseSearch oninput listener is unthrottled; filtering 5,000 exercises across all muscle groups generates massive DOM reflows taking ~180 ms.

getLogLinearSearch.analysis: getLog uses exerciseLogs.find() linear search; calling 21 times per frame over 10,000 logs performs 210,000 iterations, degrading render time from 12 ms to 95 ms.

governance.goalDisabledRationale: 0% test coverage, inline HTML string escaping risks, synchronous data overwrites.
governance.scheduleEnabledRationale: Safe non-destructive static health scans, schema verification, storage monitoring.
